text:
To Raúl Rivero

I carry a fantastic, tremendous lily;

beautiful outside and inside bad.

It frightens me with its thirst. I give it, I

sell it,

I gift it to anyone who passes.


Let it go grow; tall, upright,

in the hardest earth of another

shoulder.

To me it gives loose pain in the chest,

solitary and standing like

rubble.


Its impoverished reflection bothers me,

its not wanting to become oblivion,


its intolerable and ashen silk.


Take it away from me! Quickly... I ask it.

Make a blind heart,

abolished,

of this lily that at last settles in me!

translation.title: The Lily
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the dedication and the lily as beautiful, bad, and painfully lodged.
